content_metadata.description: This video is an interview with Meagan Holman, a member of the Milwaukee Public Schools board, on election night. She expresses her excitement about the Democratic wins, particularly the increase of women in the US Senate. The interviewer then asks about her experience with the Obama administration, leading Meagan to talk about her personal life as a mother and school board member, and how Obama's policies have positively affected her family and community.
